Mixed purées

Veal with vegetables

Zöldséges borjú

6 months+ Sound idea 40 min 4 portions

Beef works the same way as veal. Serve it fully cooked, with no salt. The point of the dish is the iron.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 120 g beef or veal stewing meat (lean, raw weight; either meat is a sound choice)
  • 100 g carrot (peeled weight)
  • 120 g ripe tomato (peeled, fresh)
  • 40 g onion (peeled)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Cut the meat, peeled carrot, peeled tomato, and onion into small pieces.
  2. Cover with unsalted water and cook until the meat is fully done and the vegetables are soft.
  3. Check there is no pink in the middle of the meat.
  4. Blend until smooth, with a little cooking water if needed.
  5. Do not add salt.

Sound idea

Veal is sometimes treated as a special food, but it is not nutritionally better than beef. Salt is often added to a meat sauce.

Use beef or veal, since both are equal choices. Cook the meat with carrot, tomato, and onion until fully done, then blend, and do not add salt.
